notes.title: Round 13 of the Beat the Gods Competition starts now!
notes.content:
We are back!
Round 13 of the community event "Beat the Gods" starts now! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24329565/6bdee58c9c67346ebea9906560b5e5f4c47ef4c0.png

The System

This week features 5 Maps. Set a time and try to beat the time of the gods!
If you beat the gods on at least 3 maps, you will win this Round!
Gods’ time is calculated by the average of each individual god’s time!
For the “All Powerup Map”: The time for you to beat is calculated by the average of the top 3 of gods’ times.
At the end of the round you will get points for every level you've played.
The average time of the gods will be used as reference for a SRPR of 10,000.

We decided to reward winners (beat 3 gods at least) and the the best player if no player beats the gods: 
Round 13 Prize Pool:

Gods are beaten:

1st: 75% ($45)
2nd: 25% ($15)
Gods are not beaten:

1st: 25% ($15)
2nd: 0% ($0)


Prize Pool: $60 USD

Rules:


 Replays are locked.
 At the end of the week the replays and the times, as well as a spreadsheet with points will be released. No need to sign up, everyone can participate
 Gentle's Bounce is banned
 Subject to modification
 Macros and scripts are banned 
 Major evidence of cheating leads to disqualification and permanent ban from the competition
 NEW: Every former god is excluded from competition.
 NEW: Former cheaters are also banned from competing.

Schedule:


 Start: August 17th 8pm CET
 End: August 24th 8pm CET

Gods this Round:

Snail489, Klooger
ThyBreadKing, Mixtraa
Sev3n, Royal
sSolle, Royal

All Powerups
Snail489, ThyBreadKing, Klooger, Sev3n, Royal, Mixtraa


Disclaimer: Beat the Gods is a contest organized solely by our awesome community, and Pine Studio has nothing to do with it. \m/

notes.title: A new DLC and a free update are coming this fall!
notes.content:
To celebrate the biggest sale yet, we have a few good news to announce! 

The first and the most exciting is that we are working on a FREE update and a new DLC! Both are coming out this fall! To name a few things that we plan to add to the game: 

 New floor with 11 new levels! 
 New powerup! 
 Two new modifiers. 
 A few long-awaited fixes. (you know what I'm talking about ;)) 
 New "League system".

We have one more awesome surprise, but more on that in August! 

Btw, we are also working on a really cool project called Escape Simulator. Check it out, and don't forget to wishlist! <3 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435790/Escape_Simulator/?utm_source=seum&utm_campaign=landing 

To new speedrunners: have fun! \m/
Pine Studio team

notes.title: Season 8 update and super hot discounts!
notes.content:
Dear Speedrunners, 

It’ll be a cold day in Hell before we run out of new seasons! Season 8 is now officially open, so set your sights on the top of the leaderboard and don’t settle for anything less.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24329565/30a3fefff6f64e953ed95141207f555274814199.png
To make sure that awesome news comes in pairs, we’re happy to share that SEUM is currently 70% off (biggest discount yet!!), while “Drunk Side of the Moon” and the brain-melting soundtrack are also at 60% of their usual price.

Grab ‘em while they’re HOT! \m/

We’re also working on an update with some long-awaited fixes which got a little delayed because of the release of our newest title “The Academy”. We expect it to be ready in a month’s time, along with a new season maybe...

We hope you’re all safe and well, hit us with your best speedruns and awesome feedback! 

Stay fast,  \m/
Pine Team

* Can't jump from spawnpoint anymore
* Snapback when spawning

notes.title: DLC is out now! + Free Update!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/db2684e472bf8a2662b911cf26512aabad3e8545.gif
Hi, Speedrunners! 
Today we are proud to announce "The Drunk Side of the Moon", the first DLC Expansion for SEUM. It brings a ton of new content to the original game including 3 new powerups, 33 new levels, and new speedrun mutators! 
https://youtu.be/6G7KptTt1dw
What's on the Drunk side of the Moon? 

    Roar
(New Powerup!): Point and fly, super-fast way to fly through levels. It feels like guiding a Redeemer on steroids.
    Rocket
(New Powerup!): Now you can rocket jump, and it’s fun. But we haven’t stopped there! You can actually jump on the rocket and ride it! Going too slow? No problem shoot the rocket with a fireball to give it an extra boost.
    Shadow World 
(New Powerup!): Explore specially crafted levels from the two viewpoints: the world of light and the world of shadows.
Speedrun mutators
Speedrun mode now has mutators which allow you to play speedrun mode by having a powerup of your choosing when you start the level. Replay the old levels with completely new strategies.


We also just released the new game update which marks the beginning of the Season 4. 
To celebrate, the game will be 66.6% off from tomorrow (21st Oct), and you can get the new DLC Expansion now for just 5 bucks! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/457210
Hope you'll like the new content.  
Happy speedrunning! \m/ 

-Pine Studio

notes.title: SEUM Level Editor Contest!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/efdb32b5e73b2c6034fb14217ff94a64065e0986.gif
Hey Speedrunners, 

we are hosting our first Level Design Contest. Try out our new level editor, make a cool level, publish it on Steam Workshop and you are in for the  prize!
This time you can win SEUM T-shirt, the original soundtrack on vinyl and extra SEUM key.
The winner will be announced on December 25th. 

We're looking forward to see what you all come up with! 

Patch Notes

    Added replay option on the community maps
    Scores now work correctly 
    Fixed Mac and Linux editor bugs
    Added map sorting 
    Performance improvements


Pine Studio

PS. There are already more than 100 community levels. You guys are awesome!

notes.title: SEUM Level Editor Update is out!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/9f7a5f2c027a29fac446ef033a0d403567f76ce8.jpg
The Level editor is the feature SEUM community has been longing for ever since the game came out. We are proud to announce that our free Level Editor Update is out and available in-game. 
https://youtu.be/sZFvizl29cg
Enjoy local craft brews done by our awesome community! A.k.a. player made levels for SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell. To make your own: start SEUM and select "Workshop" from the main menu.
To celebrate the update SEUM is 40% off!

Have fun! 
Pine Studio

notes.title: Worship Halloween in SEUM!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/a6360c7b8057a739e031857d787977a608ffd0e7.gif
In order to celebrate Halloween, we made a small update to SEUM. Besides making it a little festive, we have a little treat for you... if you're able to find it. ;)

"To make pumpkin pies,
one needs to smash them properly,
'til no bits remain."

We're also including small fixes:

Extras screen shows the correct percentages.
Score uploading has been made more robust.
Speedrun mode for EP.
Updated translations.

Have a haunted and metal Halloween! \m/
-Pine Studio

notes.title: SEUM "Season II" update is out now!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/0ae7862eff667d9a83e10f132cc50850c8057c1b.jpg

Two months after the release, SEUM is ready for the first big update and sale! 

    Cleansing of the leaderboards 
The new update opens the gates of Season II by resetting all leaderboard scores. The best players from Season I will get their special place in the "Pit of Infamy" and will be remembered until the end of times.
    Replays 
You can now watch replays of other players.
    Extended play 
A free map pack with 11 new levels. 
    More languages 
Beer, Bier, cerveza, bière, piwo,пиво, or pivo... whatever you like!

To celebrate the beginning of Season II, the game is available at a huge discount of 35%! Now it's the right time to try SEUM!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/457210/
-Pine Studio \m/

notes.title: SEUM update #03
notes.content:
Focus of this update is still mostly bug fixes. But, we also included a little gift for you in the "Extras" section! ;)

Speedrun mode:

     Displaying correct time differences from the best run
     Fixed problem with falling in level 82
     Fixed an issue with extra time appearing on timer
     Fixed an issue with needing to go through gate multiple times when failing to collect a beer
     You can show leaderboards by pressing TAB

Endless mode:

     You can't fall endlessly anymore
     You can now shoot through power-taking forcefield

Misc:

 Added multiple missing sounds
 You should see your saved progress even in odd situations with bad Steam login
 Added a cover image for soundtrack
 Fov slider can now go higher than 90
 Added ability to change which screen the game is displayed on
 Updated to new version of Unity engine 5.4.0p1

notes.title: SEUM update #02
notes.content:
We've added a new stats page in "Extras" section of the main menu which shows the total progress of the game, including all bonuses.
 
We fixed a few things in the game as well: 

 Made score uploading more robust
 Full game speedrun now unlocks
 All achievements should now work correctly (666%, Beat a friend, Hardcore Runner)

Happy SEUMing!

notes.title: SEUM update #01
notes.content:
The devs are listening and we are more than happy that you are not reporting too many bugs! :)
We fixed a few things in the game: 

 Fixed timings on some levels
 Added support for binding more mouse buttons
 Fixed problems with control bindings resetting
 Fixed endless mode shooting bug
 Fixed restart bug in hardcore speedrun mode

SEUM Demo was still in beta version and today we updated it to the current state of the game. Check it out and try 11 levels for free!

notes.title: SEUM is coming out July 28!! \m/
notes.content:
A month ago SEUM demo was released and by now more than 1.5 Million  (virtual) deaths are recorded. It really proved that it's a bastard child of Quake 3 and Super Meat Boy.
Today we are proud to announce that "SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell" will be 
available on July 28.!!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24329565/2a3ef82660a1f0dd12bf02c06a0cbf18e43b0e51.png

In addition, the closed BETA is nearly finished and keys will be sent out in the course of the next week. The closed BETA will contain all 100 maps of the full game, most of them in their final state.

Thank you all for playing and supporting SEUM! \m/

- Pine Studio team
